description: Fork of exp533 (trainable anchors on all 4 LUTs). SINGLE change: anchor_init_std 1.0 -> 0.2. exp533 diagnosis: at init_std=1.0 the anchor argmax gaps are too wide to flip (only ~0.55% of anchors moved by step 1000, flip rate DECELERATING even at full LR) -> anchors effectively frozen at random init, landing ~+0.011 bpb worse than exp530's fixed canonical-coverage anchors. Smaller init_std => ~5x narrower top-1/top-2 logit gaps => anchors actually flippable, testing whether plastic anchors can beat fixed coverage. Everything else identical to exp533: anchor_lr=3e-4 (AdamW, cosine), lut_lr=2e-4 (LION), same naps/tphs, 8000 steps, bs=16, per-block ckpt. Watch anchor_flips.csv for movement and whether the gap vs exp530 (1.4731) closes. NOTE: small init makes anchors plastic EARLY (volatile, crystallize as logits separate) -- watch for early-thrashing in the loss curve. Schedule-based 'plastic-late' variant deferred. vs exp533 (init1.0), exp530 1.4731, exp513 1.4825.
